summary: time billable-confirmation first slice on BASE 61950e1. Created pmo_plugins.time as a new plugin app (manifest exactly 8 fields with requires={contracts} and empty capabilities; own migration time/0001_initial; settings INSTALLED_APPS + PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES and pmo_plugins/delivery/urls root single-write binding) whose first slice only owns BillableConfirmation (canonical x-owner=time owned_fact): organization, draft/confirmed status (reversed enum reserved but not produced), timesheet_ref (namespace=time/kind=timesheet/version), contract_line_ref (contracts), confirmed_minutes 1..1440, confirmed_on, evidence>=1, version, created_by/confirmed_by/confirmed_at, create_token/digest, plus BillableConfirmationReceipt with action draft.save/confirm. Migration 0001 installs SQLite and PostgreSQL guards: inserts only draft; draft business fields (timesheet/contract refs, minutes, date, evidence) are editable with version+1 while identity/create fields stay frozen; one draft->confirmed transition with confirmer present, creator != confirmer and the final business facts frozen; confirmed facts immutable and undeletable; receipts immutable. A draft-edit regression edits minutes/evidence, confirms, and verifies the confirmation uses the edited values. Services save_billable_confirmation_draft and confirm_billable enforce company lock, fresh role/module checks (disabled module write refusal, history read retained), read-only core.services.approved_timesheet_for_billable (approved same-org timesheet, minutes not exceeded), read-only contracts.approved_line_snapshot (single approved version, confirmed_time template, same project, as-of effective date), period/lock/future-date checks, one confirmed per timesheet+contract line, idempotent receipts with replay/changed-input conflict, and independent confirmation (creator cannot confirm). Confirmation writes exactly one canonical time.billable_confirmed.v1 (source=confirmation ref, changed_refs=[confirmation, timesheet, contract_line], posting_event_refs=[]) with a suppressed plugin.time.billable.confirmed audit source, and writes no revenue, ledger, cash or open-item fact. Browser list/form/confirm views and domain-metadata routes are wired; verify_integrity adds the time branch (status/minutes/reference existence and same org/timesheet+line state/envelope/one confirmed per pair/self-confirmation/no financial event or source consumption). Known integration dependency: because time requires contracts, three pre-existing dependency-guard tests that hard-code the dependants to disable now also need 'time', and the cash verify query-count ceiling 80 becomes 82 (needs 84); per Lead ruling these four cross-slice test edits are handled by a whitelist correction + integration sync after this PR, so the full suite currently shows the known 8 macOS baseline failures plus these 4 attributable, disclosed failures (expected to return to baseline after sync). Final integration on BASE 7d8877f after the PH-273 whitelist correction: the four disclosed cross-slice test files are now in PH-269's allowed_paths, so they were minimally synced (the three dependency-disable/order loops add time; the cash bridge verify query-count ceiling was raised 80->84 with a comment while keeping the constant-across-history assertion). The full suite is back to the known 8 macOS baseline failures only (951 tests, 5F+3E/69 skips).
